name: codegraph
description: Codebase knowledge-graph tools for Codex: retrieve code structure and design context, explore symbols and tests, index projects into a local graph, and run decomposition/design pipelines.

interface.shortDescription: Codebase knowledge-graph retrieval, indexing, and design tools
interface.longDescription: Query the codegraph knowledge graph for code structure, symbols, tests, requirements, and design memory; index projects into a local SQLite graph (or opt-in Neo4j); and run HLR decomposition and OO design pipelines with verification stubs.
